name: Jason Clark

summary.text: Jason Ray Clark is a Colorado native and entrepreneur running for U.S. House in Colorado's 6th District; he previously sought the 2026 Republican nomination for Governor of Colorado.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1988 to 1995 and graduated from the United States Military Academy (West Point) in 1992.

experience.text: Bachelor's degree, United States Military Academy, 1992; high school diploma, Smoky Hill High School.
Worked as an entrepreneur, including in the investment industry.

finance.note: No financial report on file with the FEC as of 2026-10-14. Candidates must file once they raise or spend more than $5,000.

research_notes: Clark's 2026 U.S. House Candidate Connection survey response was very brief (three key messages: Affordability, Jobs, Crime; policy passion: limited government), with no specifics on abortion, guns, immigration, energy, or other statements. Used his more detailed 2025 Candidate Connection survey from his concurrent run for Governor of Colorado, where available, since it is his own words on the same underlying positions; dates are estimated to the first of the survey year since Ballotpedia does not give exact dates. His survey response also describes a legal dispute with the Colorado Attorney General's office over his securities license; this is his own account and was not independently corroborated, so it was left out of the summary. No campaign finance activity reported for this race as of the page's last update ($0). No official campaign website specific to the U.S. House race was found; the site used appears to be his repurposed gubernatorial campaign site. WebSearch budget was exhausted mid-research, limiting further lead-finding for this candidate.
